The textures of the baked goods are overly smooth and uniform, lacking the fine crumb detail or irregularities expected in real photography. They appear slightly 'waxy' or plastic-like.
The vertical lines of the window mullions behind the neon sign show slight warping and do not align perfectly parallel, suggesting minor geometric instability.
